releaseTitle: AdSkip Pro v1.0.39 - Instant Static Picture & Banner Ad Skipping
releaseNotes:
* Instant Static Picture Ad Skipping: Completely eliminates the 20-second video waiting deferral for static/banner interstitial ads, dismissing them immediately on appearance with human-like jitter
* On-Device Cross Glyph Detector: Direct bitmap pixel contrast scanning reliably identifies standalone '✕' and '+' dismissal crosses across top corners even when rendered without circular badges or text labels
* Google AdMob Header Companion Matching: Automatically pairs AdMob header elements ('Ad ·', 'Close ad', 'AdChoices') to locate and tap top close buttons with high priority
* 500ms Fast Watchdog for Static Ads: Accelerates scanning cadence to 500ms during static image ads and reduces fallback back-press timeout to 7-10s instead of 28s
* Dedicated Vision UI & Autonomous Unlocking: Maintains full on-device ML Kit OCR & shape detection, continuous multi-episode celebration unlocks, and zero cloud dependencies
